name: Salvager Three
description: Salvager Three was a freighter, bought by Shug Ninx, used as cover to enter Byss space by Salla Zend to retrieve her ship, the Starlight Intruder (they would later discover that it had been scrapped). Salvager Three was likely left behind by the pair on Byss after they decided to leave Byss with Ninx's Starhook Ten and a group of recently evacuated Rebels or modified to become Starhook Ten.
